entries.title: Matthew 11:1
segments: After finishing his instructions to his twelve disciples, Jesus left that place, in order to teach and to preach in the neighboring cities.

entries.title: Matthew 11:2
segments: But when John heard, in the prison, what the Christ was doing, he sent by some of his disciples to ask him,

entries.title: Matthew 11:3
segments: "Are you the Coming One, or are we to look for someone else?"

entries.title: Matthew 11:4
segments: "Go and tell John," was Jesus' answer, "what you hear and see;

entries.title: Matthew 11:5
segments: " the blind are seeing the lame are walking, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf are hearing, the dead are being raised up, and the gospel is being preached to the poor.

entries.title: Matthew 11:6
segments: "And blessed is the man who finds no cause of stumbling in me."

entries.title: Matthew 11:7
segments: As these men started to go away, Jesus began to speak to the throngs, about John.

entries.title: Matthew 11:8
segments: "What did you go out into the desert to behold?" he asked; "A reed shaken by the wind? If not, what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, those who wear soft raiment dwell in kings' palaces!

entries.title: Matthew 11:9
segments: "But why did you go? To see a prophet? I tell you, yes, and more than a prophet;

entries.title: Matthew 11:10
segments: "for this is he of whom it is written: "Behold, I send my messenger before your face, And he will prepare your road for thee.

entries.title: Matthew 11:11
segments: "In solemn truth I tell you that there has not arisen among those born of women a greater than John the Baptist; yet one of the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

entries.title: Matthew 11:12
segments: "From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by storm.

entries.title: Matthew 11:13
segments: "For the prophets and the Law prophesied until John;

entries.title: Matthew 11:14
segments: "and, if you are willing to receive it, he is the Elijah who was to come.

entries.title: Matthew 11:15
segments: "Let all who have ears, listen!

entries.title: Matthew 11:16
segments: "To what shall I compare this generation? It is like little children sitting in the market-place, who call to the other children,

entries.title: Matthew 11:17
segments: "saying: 'We have piped to you and you have not danced; We have wailed, but you have not beaten your breasts.'

entries.title: Matthew 11:18
segments: "For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they said, 'He has a demon';

entries.title: Matthew 11:19
segments: and the Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, 'Lo, a glutton and a wine-drinker, a friend of tax-gatherers and sinners!' Nevertheless, Wisdom is justified by her deeds."

entries.title: Matthew 11:20
segments: Then he began to upbraid the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they had not repented:

entries.title: Matthew 11:21
segments: "Woe unto you, Chorazin! Woe unto you, Bethsaida! Because if the mighty works which have been done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented, long ago, in sackcloth and ashes.

entries.title: Matthew 11:22
segments: "Moreover, I tell you it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the Day of Judgment, than for you.

entries.title: Matthew 11:23
segments: "And you too, Capernaum! Will you be exalted even to heaven? You shall go down to the Place of Death! For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which have been done in you, it would have remained until this day.

entries.title: Matthew 11:24
segments: "I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the Day of Judgment, than for you."

entries.title: Matthew 11:25
segments: At that time Jesus answered and said: "I praise thee, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You hast hidden these things from the wise and wary, and hast revealed them to the children.

entries.title: Matthew 11:26
segments: "Even so, Father, for so it seemed good in your sight.

entries.title: Matthew 11:27
segments: "Everything has been handed over to me by my Father; neither does any one know the Son, except the Father, nor any one know the Father except the Son, and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.

entries.title: Matthew 11:28
segments: "Come unto me, all who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

entries.title: Matthew 11:29
segments: "Take my yoke upon you and learn of me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

entries.title: Matthew 11:30
segments: "For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light."
